comment: A person's role (student, instructor, owner) on a course.

columns.name: campus_id
columns.comment: Campus this course person belongs to.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Surrogate identifier for the course person, auto-generated by the database and unique across the whole system.

columns.name: person_id
columns.comment: Person holding this role. Unique together with campus_id and course_id: the same person can't be given the same role assignment on the same course twice.

columns.name: course_role
columns.comment: Role this person holds on the course (e.g. Student, Instructor, Owner) -- references course_person_role.code.
